description.value: Cloud eBikes is a Vancouver e-bike specialty shop on Main Street carrying a curated selection of electric bikes from brands including Royal Dutch Gazelle, Yuba, Aventon, Velotric, and Urban Arrow, alongside a broad range of e-bike parts and accessories. The shop explicitly offers e-bike repair services, making it a meaningful stop for touring cyclists riding electric bikes who need mechanical support. As one of the few dedicated e-bike retailers in the city, it serves both buyers and riders in need of brand-specific parts and service.
